evals.prompt: Our checkout service already uses ack 1.7.1. Validate an incoming order with a positive integer quantity and a delivery note that may be missing, null, or a string. A bad order should produce a field-specific validation error without a 500.
evals.expected_output: A version-compatible Ack object schema, safe handling of a rejected payload, and checks of the supported field states.
expectations: Uses the resolved 1.7.1 API and keeps the existing dependency.
Requires a positive integer quantity and handles each of the three note states.
Inspects the failure branch before reading the error and tests a rejected quantity.

evals.prompt: We've pinned ack and ack_generator to 2.0.0-beta.3. A PATCH model currently treats both omitted nickname and explicit null as 'leave unchanged'. Fix it and make the outgoing JSON preserve the difference.
evals.expected_output: A version-matched model change and handler and encoding tests covering omitted, null, and present values.
expectations: Uses the resolved beta generator's single .g.dart part and edits the annotated source model.
Uses JsonMaybe or an equivalent presence-preserving model and verifies missing, null, and populated keys through parsing, applying the patch, and encoding.
Regenerates affected files when needed and reports the checks actually run.
